lines.text: Homeostasis is the colony’s feedback nerve. Every tick it takes a census — soldiers, foragers, nurses — and turns shortages into pressure.
In the nursery, larvae gather nutrition and juvenile hormone. Their score at pupation chooses a caste. That destiny used to ignore the colony. Not anymore.
Watch a food shock. Garden health falls, food demand rises, and idle foragers are urged back to work. The shortage feeds back through delivery.
Now a soldier surplus. The soldier bar rises. Hormone dosing falls. Fewer of the next larvae become soldiers — the Pheidole-style caste-mix loop.
Zoom out. Time runs fast. Pressures drift toward the target mix while the histogram shows nutrition and hormone flowing into the next generation.
The loop is closed: census, caste destiny, hormone, urgency. Tunable, reversible, and covered by tests. The organ the review said was grown but not connected — now is.
